reasoning: 驗證目標：電台支援 RT+ 時，HU 以收到的文字資訊填入 artist 與 song 欄位。關鍵情境條件：電台是否送出 RT+ 標記的曲目資訊——兩個值類都要觀察，只驗有 RT+ 的一側無法排除「欄位以其他來源填入」的實作（§7）。為什麼這樣切：一條 TC 內以支援與不支援 RT+ 的兩個電台涵蓋條文的條件句，依 §5.7 屬同一驗證目標。條文末句「Please refer to CFTS024-707 for HU behavior requirements when radiotext is available」依 R11 為引用式：token 逐字多引、ER 以引用錨定，不驗 CFTS024-707 自身的規則面（radiotext 可得時的顯示規格、捲動與更新時序）。037 title 未帶該引用句（相似度 0.855），依 §8.6 以 CFTS 條文為準，引用因此進入本 leaf。刻意略過：song/audio tagging 的後續動作（標記如何儲存與使用）不在本條文內，未生成。

tcs.tc_title: Radio Text Plus populates the artist and song fields
tcs.test_item: Radiotext (RT) and Radio Text Plus (RT +): Feature to transmit textual information related to the current station. If the currently tuned station supports RT +, this feature allows HU to populate the artist and song field as well as to enable song/audio tagging
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An FM/AM signal generator is ready
2. The vehicle is configured for a market where the RDS feature set applies, such as EMEA - Europe
3. The HU Tuner source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
4. The HU is in FM analog tuner mode
tcs.input_test_data:
Station R: broadcasts radiotext with RT+ tagging carrying a known artist name and song title
Station S: broadcasts radiotext without RT+ tagging
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Tune the HU to station R
2. Read the artist and song fields on the FM Radio Playing page
3. Tune the HU to station S
4. Read the artist and song fields on the FM Radio Playing page
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU is tuned to station R and the radiotext is presented as defined by CFTS024-707
2. The artist field holds the artist name and the song field holds the song title broadcast by station R
3. The HU is tuned to station S
4. The artist and song fields are not populated from station S
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
